notes.filesystem: Provides file system access for MCP server development. Set the working directory to your MCP server project root.
notes.github: Requires GitHub Personal Access Token. Create one at https://github.com/settings/tokens with repo scope.
notes.context7: Requires Context7 API key. Sign up at https://context7.ai to obtain an API key for protocol documentation queries.
notes.fetch: No authentication required. Used for testing HTTP/SSE endpoints during development.
